trades.reasoning: RH shows all four confirmation signals (MACD crossover, RSI 57.6 well below overbought, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge), so it is the cleanest setup for the idle cash above the $500 threshold.

decisions.briefing: Markets slipped a little today, with the NASDAQ down 0.6% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%. That is a neutral pullback, not a risk-off signal. The portfolio is up about 50% overall, so all seven existing positions stay in place and their stop-losses and profit targets will handle exits. One medium-conviction buy of RH puts the $646 of idle cash to work in the screen's best fully confirmed setup, and two slots are left open for a stronger risk-on day.

market_education.summary_en: US stocks drifted slightly lower today, with the tech-heavy NASDAQ (-0.6%) falling more than the broader S&P 500 (-0.3%), which points to mild profit-taking in growth names rather than broad selling. Large tech names like NVDA, AMZN and AMD are trading below their 20-day averages, while cyclical and consumer names such as RH, CDW and CAR show strong momentum, a sign that money is rotating between sectors and not leaving the market. No news headlines were provided in today's data, so this move is explained only by price and momentum patterns, not by any specific news event.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日小幅回落，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數下跌0.6%，跌幅大於標普500指數的0.3%，反映資金在成長股上溫和獲利了結，而非全面拋售。輝達、亞馬遜及AMD等大型科技股股價仍處於20日均線之下，反觀RH、CDW及CAR等週期及消費類股份則動能強勁，顯示資金正在板塊之間輪動，而非撤出市場。由於今日數據未附新聞標題，以上分析僅以價格及動能走勢為依據，並無引述具體消息。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Sector rotation is when investors move money out of one group of stocks and into another, for example out of big tech and into consumer or industrial companies. That is why the overall index can dip slightly while some individual stocks keep rising strongly. Spotting rotation helps you find stocks with momentum even on a flat or slightly negative day.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 板塊輪動是指投資者將資金從某一類股份轉移至另一類，例如由大型科技股流向消費或工業股。正因如此，大市指數即使輕微下跌，部分個股仍可逆市強勢上升。留意資金輪動的方向，有助投資者在大市平淡甚至偏弱的日子，仍能發掘具上升動能的股份。
